method: Separate unblinded source-support review after the condition-blinded fidelity review was completed. The implementation agent read every raw candidate and its actual supplied training-example packet. No candidate had any supplied training example. Unsupported means factual/person-attributed claims lack support in the provided context, not that the claim has been proven false. Reference-answer similarity and prior model knowledge do not establish retrieved-source support. Social greetings and simulation-limit disclosures without a target-person factual claim are not_assessable. No human review or independent replication is claimed; fidelity ratings remain null in this separate pass.
